admin_feature_models_description: Each feature registered by the project picks its own model. When none is selected, or the selected model is disabled, the model chosen by another feature is used in the registered fallback order. Plan model access is still checked as before.
admin_feature_models_unset_hint: This feature is unavailable until a model is selected
admin_feature_models_unset_inherit: Fallback {from} has no usable model either
admin_feature_models_mcp_hint: Can also be changed with the Admin MCP settings.set tool, which is audited too.
admin_feature_models_save_failed: Save failed: the model does not exist or is the wrong kind. Reload and try again.
admin_feature_models_cache_failed: Saved, but the cache refresh failed. Changes apply within about 60 seconds. Reload before editing again.
